[LLEX.15.2.1] Standard lexer errors (non-exhaustive). The first column names the
kind for this table; a compiler's message need not use those words:

| Error kind | Example trigger |
|---|---|
| `lone carriage return` | `\r` not followed by `\n` |
| `inconsistent indentation` | indent not a multiple of 4 (outside bracket groups; see LLEX.6.4, LLEX.7.5.5) |
| `inconsistent dedent` | dedent to a column no enclosing block used |
| `unexpected character` | any character outside the legal alphabet: a `\t`, or U+FEFF anywhere other than offset 0, among them |
| `invalid identifier` | a character glued to a name that [LNAM.2.2] does not admit |
| `ellipsis not valid in DS` | `...` in source |
| `lone '!' is not a valid token` | `!` followed by neither `=` nor `~` |
| `unterminated string literal` | EOF before closing `"` or `"""` |
| `invalid numeric literal` | `0x_FF`, `1_.5`, `42_` |
| `integer literal out of range` | > 2⁶³−1 |
| `unterminated bracket group` | `(`, `[`, or `{` with no match |
| `mismatched bracket` | `)` without matching `(` |
